verdict.rationale: Deepgram has no native natural-language console for operating the product. However, its dg CLI ships a first-party built-in MCP server that gives AI tools such as Claude Code direct access to Deepgram APIs, and the CLI auto-detects AI agent environments and adjusts its behavior. That lets users drive transcription, TTS and account management through natural-language prompts in an MCP-capable agent. The Voice Agent API and intent recognition are features for building end-user apps, not for operating Deepgram itself, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface within Deepgram's own console or CLI, documentation of which operations are exposed as MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
